neighbours.label: the end of a clause that holds against an expectation (even if / even though / no matter how / myth vs reality), usually its final period or comma
fire: Some people think cash is safer. Even if the account was never meant for public use, it was still visible to anyone who looked it up. The bank later changed its policy.
Remember, do not carry alcohol onto the school grounds, even if you are over the legal drinking age. The campus is treated as a dry zone.
Old manuscripts were rarely copied word for word, no matter how carefully a scribe might work toward that goal. Every copy added its own errors.

Myth: Fresh fruit is always healthier than frozen.
Reality: Frozen and dried fruit are often packed within hours of picking.
The old bridge, even though badly rusted, still carries more traffic than the new one. Engineers are surprised every year.
Although longer hours could create more jobs, I am worried about what effect this new rule might have. Small shops will suffer first.
Even when the evidence is clear, many voters stick to what they already believed. Facts alone rarely change minds.
You must still file a tax return, even if you earned no money at all during the year. The office will send a reminder.
quiet: Some people think cash is safer. The account was opened for public use, and it is visible to anyone who looks it up. The bank later changed its policy.
Remember, bring your student card onto the school grounds every day of the week. The campus office checks cards at the gate.
Old manuscripts were copied by hand in large rooms called scriptoria during the winter months. Every copy took months to finish.

Tip: Fresh fruit tastes best in summer.
Advice: Buy fruit at a local market early in the morning.
The old bridge, built in 1890, carries more traffic than the new one. Engineers inspect it every year.
Longer opening hours will start next month, and the council has published the new rule online. Small shops will open later.
When the results came out, many voters read about them in the morning paper. The turnout was high.
You must file a tax return by the end of April each year. The office will send a reminder.
